newsitem.title: USA: IBM to unveil ThinkPad with new design. [CORRECTED 22:00 GMT]
newsitem.headline: IBM to unveil ThinkPad with new design. [CORRECTED 22:00 GMT]

text.p: International Business Machines Corp said that it will unveil Tuesday a new ThinkPad notebook computer with an "all-in-one design," integrating a hard drive, a floppy drive and a CD-ROM in one unit.
IBM's ThinkPad line previously has included the floppy drive as an external device, attached via a cable.

The ThinkPad 380 Series also has a 12.1 inch screen, a Pentium microprocessor at varying speeds and the computing power of a desktop computer. Estimated reseller prices for the ThinkPad 380 start at $2,199, depending on the model.

The models come standard with 16 megabytes (corrects from megabits) of memory, a full duplex speaker providing excellent sound quality, an external microphone jack and stereo speaker or headphone jack.
IBM said the ThinkPad 380 is aimed at general business and consumer users. The model 380 will be available through IBM resellers and the 385D is available through retail stores.

IBM has a Web site, (http://www.pc.ibm.com/thinkpad/tp380) where customers can participate in a contest where a ThinkPad 380 and ThinkPad related prizes will be awarded every week for six weeks, beginning Tuesday. ThinkPad purchasers can also get refunds on accessories, such as carrying cases or modems.
